button.label: All like largest
button.supertip: Resizes every selected shape to the size of the largest (by area) shape in the selection.

button.label: All like smallest
button.supertip: Resizes every selected shape to the size of the smallest (by area) shape in the selection.

button.label: Stretch left edge to reference
button.supertip: Moves each shape's LEFT edge to the reference shape's left edge; the right edge stays.

button.label: Stretch right edge to reference
button.supertip: Moves each shape's RIGHT edge to the reference shape's right edge; the left edge stays.

button.label: Stretch top edge to reference
button.supertip: Moves each shape's TOP edge to the reference shape's top edge; the bottom edge stays.

button.label: Stretch bottom edge to reference
button.supertip: Moves each shape's BOTTOM edge to the reference shape's bottom edge; the top edge stays.

button.label: Fixed gap horizontal…
button.supertip: Places the shapes left-to-right with an exact gap in cm; the leftmost shape anchors the row.

button.label: Fixed gap vertical…
button.supertip: Places the shapes top-to-bottom with an exact gap in cm; the topmost shape anchors the column.

button.label: Stack horizontally (zero gap)
button.supertip: Abuts the shapes left-to-right with no gap.

button.label: Stack vertically (zero gap)
button.supertip: Abuts the shapes top-to-bottom with no gap.

button.label: Arrange in grid…
button.supertip: Lays the selection out in N columns. Shapes are placed in SELECTION order; the reference shape's top-left corner is the grid origin.

menu.label: Select same
menu.supertip: Extends the selection to every shape on the slide matching the reference (first-selected) shape.

button.label: Deck language
button.supertip: Sets the proofing language of EVERY text frame — slides, notes, masters and layouts — in one go.

button.label: EN
button.supertip: One click: sets the proofing language of the WHOLE deck to English (UK).

button.label: FR
button.supertip: One click: sets the proofing language of the WHOLE deck to French (FR).

button.label: Remove notes
button.supertip: Deletes the speaker notes of every slide (asks first) — send-out preparation.

button.label: Unused masters
button.supertip: Deletes slide masters and layouts no slide uses, and reports what was removed.

button.label: Inspector
button.supertip: Position/size read-out (in cm) of the reference shape — also a debugging aid.

button.label: Deck statistics
button.supertip: Slides, shapes, words, fonts in use, hidden and off-slide object census.
